headline: Glover Wharf facilities, transient float, and harbor projects, including Harbor Fest and the OceanTech Alliance.
summary: The meeting will cover harbor finances, Glover Wharf customers and facilities, and active and ongoing harbor projects. It will also review tabled and completed items.
items: Glover Wharf: customer updates, customer service and communication, dinghy bar and signage, commercial float security gates, hoist operations, hoist pier phase 2, public pier and walkway replacement, abandoned boat sale status, rat extermination, bait delivery and trash, missing No Fishing signs, webcam, and ice machine options
Recreational marina closes for the summer season on the third Saturday in October, and the winter season begins

Active projects: Port Harbor Marine Grady White Demo Days recap; Harbor Fest wrap-up and thoughts on 2027; transient float and moorings, including Dockwa and QR codes; Innoventure Labs OceanTech Alliance

Ongoing items: Beverly 400+ recap; adding 2 HMA members (mayor approved, to Council); GW upgrades platform design; kayak and SUP customers, wait list, and new racks; documents archiving; GW website updates; Chapter 91 licenses
Under consideration: mural under bridge, call for artists and repaint costs; e-engine charging project; vessel fueling process and logistics; other
Tabled items: 32 listed on page 2, including Falco ownership of items at GW, Downtown Docks, use of hoist, kayak racks waiting list, and Bass River public access improvements

Completed items: 68 listed on pages 3 and 4, including MCJROTC Scuba Dive Program, Abbott Street Project letter of support, GW public pier new planks, and Commercial Agreement edits and parking section
location: Beverly Library, Barnet Room or via Google Meet
